dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately falcate trailing edge characterized by a deep concavity in the lower third, transitioning into a highly irregular, serrated profile toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Irregularly truncated and jagged; the highest point lacks a consistent radius due to multiple small-scale tissue voids and nicks, creating a non-standardized multi-pointed edge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 42 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line, maintaining a mostly linear trajectory until the rounded transition to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.75:1 ratio of the total horizontal base extent to the maximum vertical protrusion height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive mechanical damage along the trailing edge and apex including at least five distinct notches of varying depths. Significant depigmented scarring and light-colored patches are visible on the lateral flank of the fin and across the dorsal surface of the body.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique saw-tooth morphological deformity at the extreme dorsal apex resulting from three adjacent, small-scale tissue excisions.
